subject: simple question about structure of summary.fitted.values in spatio-temporal model

messages.author: 778bd0cef6c473fc
messages.subject: simple question about structure of summary.fitted.values in spatio-temporal model
parts:
Here is my spatial model with a linear time term (year.ID):

formula <- y ~ f(area.ID, model=’besag’, graph=adjGraph) + year.ID + x1 + x2

mod <- inla(formula, family=’poisson’, data=data, E=Exp)

I understand that the fitted values are stored in mod$summary.fitted.values.

However, I have multiple years of data, and I am not sure how the summary.fitted.values are structured: for example, if I have 3 spatial units, is mod$summary.fitted.values structured like (1) or (2) below:


(1)

ID            Year

1              2001

2              2001

3              2001

1              2002

2              2002

3              2002

….

3              2004

 

(2)

ID            Year

1              2001

1              2002

1              2003

1              2004

2              2001

2              2002

….

3              2004

the fitted values will follow the same order as for the data itself.

so if DAT is the data.frame, then fitted.values[i, ] will correspond
to the i'th row of DAT
